name: FCA Conduct of Business Sourcebook Part 5

properties.core_policy_statement: Protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of customer data, systems, and intellectual property against threats.

properties.core_policy_statement: Establish security procedures to prevent unauthorized access, protect customer data, ensure system availability, respond to security incidents, and meet regulatory security standards.

name: Prevention of Unauthorized Access to Systems and Data
Protection of Customer Data Against Breaches

properties.risk_definition: Unauthorized access to systems and data
Breaches of customer data
Lack of system availability and reliability
Security incidents requiring rapid response

properties.scope_summary: Applies to all customer data (personal, financial), all systems and infrastructure, all staff, contractors, third parties, all physical and digital assets, and all geographic locations.

Compliance with Information Security Policy across all physical and digital assets and geographic locations
Compliance with Information Security Policy across all physical and digital assets and geographic locations

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.

properties.risk_definition: Threats to the protection of customer data and bank systems

properties.core_policy_statement: The bank adopts a security framework based on Zero-Trust, Defense-in-Depth, and the CIA Triad to ensure proactive defense and data protection.
No implicit trust is granted to users, devices, or networks; the bank assumes breach and defends proactively.
properties.scope_summary: Applies to all users, devices, and networks accessing bank systems.

properties.core_policy_statement: Implementation of multiple layers of security controls to ensure no single point of failure exists.
properties.scope_summary: Protections applied across network, system, data, and process layers.

properties.core_policy_statement: Ensuring data is encrypted and access-controlled (Confidentiality), cannot be modified without authorization (Integrity), and systems remain accessible when needed (Availability).

name: Mandatory Verification of Every Access Request
Requirement for Continuous Authentication and Authorization
Prohibition of Single Points of Failure in Security

properties.risk_definition: Access to systems or data by entities without proper authorization
properties.required_response: Continuous authentication and authorization; verification of every access request

properties.risk_definition: The compromise of security layers leading to unauthorized system entry
properties.required_response: Assume breach and defend proactively; implement layered protections (network, system, data, process)

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of authentication requirements for customers and staff across digital, physical, and remote access channels to ensure secure identity verification.

properties.verification_method: Username/password and One-Time Password (OTP) via email or SMS

specific_obligations: Provide photo ID for branch visits
Use LDAP/AD credentials for system access
Use physical badges for facility entry
Complete Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for system access

properties.core_policy_statement: Governs what users can access based on their roles, ensuring segregation of duties and comprehensive logging of system access.
Prevents a single individual from having control over all stages of a critical process.

properties.evidence_required: Logs containing who, what, when, and where

specific_obligations: Access only their own customers' data
Ensure access is captured in audit trail

properties.scope_summary: Encryption of data in transit for internet-facing connections, internal service communication, and remote access.

name: Enforcement of HTTPS and HTTP Redirection
Mandatory mTLS for Internal Service Communication
Mandatory VPN Usage for Remote Staff

specific_obligations: Utilize multi-factor authentication for VPN access

name: Information Security Policy - Data at Rest

properties.scope_summary: Encryption and sanitization requirements for databases, backups, and file storage across on-premises and cloud environments.
properties.core_policy_statement: All sensitive data at rest, including database columns, backups to S3, and file storage, must be encrypted using approved standards and securely deleted when no longer required.

name: Mandatory AES-256 Encryption for Sensitive Database Columns
Separation of Encryption Keys from Data
Mandatory Encryption for Backups to S3
Secure Deletion of Files via DoD Standard
Department of Defense (DoD) Data Sanitization Standard

properties.key_obligation: Ensure data is irrecoverable through secure overwriting during deletion.

properties.risk_definition: Unauthorized access to sensitive data stored in databases, backups, or file systems.
properties.required_response: Implementation of AES-256 encryption and secure key management.

properties.scope_summary: Perimeter security including firewalls, DDoS protection, and intrusion detection/prevention systems.
Defines the segregation of customer-facing systems, internal staff systems, database tiers, and development environments.

name: Mandatory Network Segregation of System Tiers

properties.risk_definition: Unauthorized entry into restricted network tiers or administrative sessions

properties.scope_summary: Laptops, desktops, phones, and tablets used within the bank, specifically those with customer data access
properties.core_policy_statement: Ensure all endpoints are secured via EDR, MDM, encryption, and timely patching to prevent malware and unauthorized data access.

name: Mandatory EDR Deployment and Real-time Scanning
Remote Wipe Capability for Lost Devices

properties.risk_definition: Access to customer data on lost or stolen devices

applies_to: all devices with customer data access

properties.scope_summary: Covers the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including code review, testing, and deployment processes.

properties.scope_summary: Security requirements for API Gateway implementation and API Design

properties.required_response: Implement rate limiting via API Gateway
Implement request validation and input sanitization
